subject: 2D square cylinder, normal incidence (alpha=0), vortex shedding: St = f*D/U and time-mean Cd
solver_class: 2D D2Q9 incompressible LBM (depth-averaged); must be scored against 2D references, not 3D experiment

versions.extractor: ar5iv full-text table extraction (arXiv 2411.03124v4 Table 1) + anchor text
versions.discipline: Rows are graded. VERIFIED_TABLE = number read out of a full text obtained in this mission. WITHHELD = the named original source could not be obtained and no number is written (deliberately no fabrication). TREND = an interpolation of verified rungs, explicitly NOT a referee.

notes: Anchor naming/parameter conflict (carried over from audit m16205): the anchor cites Norberg 1993 JWEIA 49:187 (DOI 10.1016/0167-6105(93)90014-f), a wind-tunnel *experiment*; but the pinned regime (Re=200, blockage 1/20) is the regime of Sohankar, Norberg & Davidson 1998 (IJNMF 26:39), the low-Reynolds-number square-cylinder blockage study. Neither original table was obtainable this mission, therefore both Re=200 rows are graded WITHHELD.

A 2D depth-averaged solver cannot be scored against a 3D wind-tunnel measurement without a documented 3D->2D correction, so the missing experimental number is not simply substituted by an experiment value.
The referee ladder used for accuracy judgement is the two *verified* rungs (Re=100, Re=150) plus the un-refereed Re=200 measurement reported as got.

Blockage 1/20 means channel height H = 20 D. Lateral faces in this case are free-stream Dirichlet (far_field_bc_2d), i.e. the walls of a 5%-blockage tunnel are represented without no-slip; the achieved blockage is measured from the mask and recorded in every case JSON.

audit_findings_2026_11_12: First machine audit (audit_reference.py) FAILED 3 of 8 graded-row checks on the as-committed reference.json -- i.e. three numbers in the referee table were not supported by the pinned full text.

Re=100 cd: ref was 1.47, a value present in NO source column (Present 1.48 / Sohankar 1.46 / Yoon 1.44); it also disagreed with the sibling verified case square_cylinder/refspec.py (REF_CD = 1.48) -- exactly the two-constants-for-one-measurement defect that audit m16183 raised. Fixed to the verbatim 'Present' value 1.48.
Re=100 st: band lower edge 0.145 is not in the pinned document (both columns read 0.147); it came from an unpinned source. Band narrowed to the documented 0.147.
Re=150 st: ref was 0.160 (a midpoint of Present 0.159 / Sohankar 0.162, i.e. an aggregate not a quoted number); ref replaced by the verbatim 'Present' 0.159, band kept as the documented 0.159-0.162.
The superseded values are retained in ref_old_unaudited / band_old_unaudited so the change is auditable rather than silent.
